rejected_inputs.note: Evaluation steps where the existing Fibonacci validator rejected the active swing pair (for example a swing high at or below its swing low); no setup was created for these.

assumptions: All P&L is mark-to-market simulation via default_calc_profit; no real broker order_calc_profit is used.
Entry is assumed at the confirming candle's close (slippage = 0).
Stop loss is the setup invalidation boundary (100.0-5000.0 points enforced by the risk engine).
Take profit is applied only when the risk policy tp_policy='fixed_rr'; otherwise exit is SL / invalidation / expiry / end-of-data.
Positions are evaluated against each historical candle's full high-low range; no tick simulation.
Daily risk reset occurs at broker/server midnight.
The risk budget, drawdown and consecutive-loss gates are exercised; rejected entries are logged but not filled.
No commissions, swaps, or financing are deducted from simulated P&L.
No external (manual) positions affect exposure during the simulated window.
Execution is simulation-only: trading_enabled=False and app_read_only=True enforced.
notes: The existing BacktestEngine produced no filled trades. Every entry signal generated at a confirmed setup was rejected by the RiskEngine, so no entry, exit or fill was simulated and trade-level profitability could not be established from the existing evaluator.

limitations: Trade-level profitability could not be established: the existing trade evaluator filled no trades (see trade_evaluation.notes).
